interface.longDescription: Research and spar in your chat, reformulate questions in three different directions, read a Resolvent world model for context or answers, and explicitly add selected findings, questions or discussion. Resolvent retrieves versioned workflow guidance from Autonomio’s reviewed GitHub release channel while installed permission, destination and review boundaries remain fixed. The organization’s approved repository contracts govern its world model. Invoking the plugin alone authorizes neither world-model reads nor writes. Select a repository or organization when model access is needed; an optional native project instruction can retain the selection. Contributions preserve evidence, uncertainty and human attribution and follow admission, independent review, current CI and authorized merge. GitHub access comes from your existing authorized connection or an available authenticated CLI. No custom MCP service, account or Portal is required. Live-reference loading and public-directory acceptance must be verified on the intended host.

publication.release_notes: Adds optional reviewed source ancestry through contribution protocol 1.2, preserving unknown ancestry, exact anchors and legacy 1.0/1.1 inputs. A read-only lineage report distinguishes declared common origins and content hashes from heuristic duplicate cues without changing independence or uncertainty.

prompts: Reformulate this question in three different directions: How could we learn which assumption matters most?
